sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) is conditionally qualified, so it should not receive new parts now. No newer document lifts this.

sources.quote: Approved blank source: Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B), single source.
Rejected. No temporary source for BR-220 without 6082-T6 capability and a closed 8D.

findings.why: The part card is a controlled record for BR-220. It lists only SUP-B as approved, so SUP-C has no approval for this part. The board already rejected SUP-C as a temporary source in DEV-127.

findings.key: 8D cracking issue on SUP-C 6082 material (id not stated)

sources.quote: the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open

findings.why: SUP-C has an open cracking 8D on 6082 material, which is the alloy family of BR-220. The 8D number is not in the documents. 8D-25-019 is a different, closed issue and belongs to SUP-B.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
Material: EN AW-6082-T6. Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.
they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310, so it should be a formality

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa (SC-BR220-YS). SUP-C is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. The claim that it is the same alloy is a phone statement that is not documented and does not show 6082-T6 capability.
